summary: Milestone 11 (Recursive Developmental Scaffolding Controller) end-to-end acceptance PASSED against the public URL (https://dev-converse.preview.emergentagent.com). Backend: 10/10 pytest passes in /app/backend/tests/test_milestone11_scaffolding_control.py — 555.85s wall time — 8 live SSE turns across 6 sessions + 2 CRUD smokes, no retries required. Frontend: all 6 UI checks passed (writing-area visible with ?dev, continue-button submits, ai-invitation renders, open-dev-panel-button opens the panel, scaffolding-control-block renders with primary_target + mode + cycle_status populated + all other fields, communicative-purpose-block still renders, new-test-session-button resets to empty writing-area). Coverage of the eight requested criteria: (a) EVERY interact populates theory.scaffolding_control — primary_target non-empty + instructional_mode in the valid set + cycle_status in {continue, consolidate_and_return, stop} — confirmed on 8/8 SSE turns across ordinary draft / multi-weakness / missing-concept / near-insight / independence-request / consolidation / body-paragraph / conclusion-draft cases. (b) SINGLE TARGET on the exact multi-weakness draft from the review request ('social media bad for friends. teens use phones alot. also my friend sarah posts alot. in conclusion social media harmful and thats my three reasons distraction and fake and addiction') — controller diagnosed 5 opportunities, selected ONE primary_target ('Forming an arguable claim (thesis function) — the foundational dependency for al...'), postponed 4, mode=explicit_instruction; the single student-facing invitation used no multi-target enumeration signals (no 'first,'/'second,'/'1)/2)' etc). (c) MODE ADAPTS — 'My essay is about social media and friendship.' yielded mode=explicit_instruction with primary_target 'Distinguish topic from claim; articulate a controlling posit...'; the capable near-insight draft ('Social media strengthens weak-tie friendships while quietly eroding the close ones...') yielded mode=developmental_question with primary_target 'Clarify what the claim commits the essay to defending — help...'. (d) INDEPENDENCE STOPS — after a first ordinary draft, an 'answer' turn with 'Got it, let me take it from here and keep writing myself.' set cycle_status=stop with stopping_reason='student requests independence', mode=consolidation, intervention.type=consolidate — no new instructional target opened. (e) CONSOLIDATION + NO ENDLESS RECURSION — a weak-claim -> real-revision -> further-revision sequence: turn1 target='Developing a controlling claim distingui...', turn2 shifted target to 'Body paragraph function' with intervention.type=consolidate (real revision produced consolidation), turn3 shifted target again to 'Draft a body paragraph that grounds the ...' with cycle_status=continue — the controller progressed to new targets rather than re-teaching the absorbed one endlessly (progressive scaffolding, not recursion). (f) M6-M10 REGRESSION — supported body paragraph: cp.primary='persuade', pf.applies=True, ef.applies=True, cf.applies=True; ending draft: concl.applies=True + completes_purpose populated; scaffolding_control populated on both. (g) M1-M5A REGRESSION — theory_history v1..v3 preserved across the 3-turn writing->revise->revise flow, currently_relevant_domains stayed 1-3 on every turn, intervention.focus='writing' + writing_not_content_check non-empty on every non-independence turn, no stage/level/grade/rubric leaks, all turns under the 180s SSE cap. (h) FRONTEND — with ?dev the workspace auto-loaded (assignment + task + writing-area visible), continue-button submitted the exact messy multi-weakness draft, ai-invitation rendered (~55s SSE), open-dev-panel-button opened the Development Panel showing the SCAFFOLDING CONTROLLER (M11) block with all populated fields — unit='whole paper', 4 diagnosed opportunities, primary target='Forming a controlling claim distinct from the topic', why (priority) rationale, mode='explicit_instruction', 3 postponed items (paragraph function / evidence development / coherence-transitions), cycle status='continue', future opportunity named — positioned between the still-rendering COMMUNICATIVE PURPOSE (M6) block and the framework blocks; new-test-session-button correctly resets to empty writing-area with no ai-invitation (verified in a clean second run — reset completes in <1s).

action_items: None blocking. Milestone 11 acceptance holds end-to-end. All eight requested criteria verified: (a) scaffolding_control populated with a single non-empty primary_target + valid instructional_mode + valid cycle_status on every turn; (b) multi-weakness draft -> one primary_target + non-empty postponed (no multi-target teaching in the invitation); (c) mode adapts (explicit_instruction for missing-concept, developmental_question for near-insight); (d) explicit independence request stops the cycle (cycle_status=stop + stopping_reason=student requests independence + mode=consolidation + iv.type=consolidate, NO new instructional target); (e) real revision consolidates and repeated revisions progress to new targets (no endless recursion on the same absorbed target); (f) M6-M10 preserved (cp.primary, pf/ef/cf.applies on paragraph, concl.applies on ending); (g) M1-M5A intact (theory_history v1..vN, relevant_domains 1-3, focus='writing', writing_not_content_check populated, no stage/level/grade/rubric leaks); (h) scaffolding-control-block renders in the frontend with all fields populated and new-test-session-button resets correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py — ScaffoldingControl Pydantic model (line 183) is precisely the shape the controller demands: one primary_target string (single target discipline enforced at the type level — you cannot accidentally return multiple), a list of postponed opportunities (deferral is explicit), diagnosed_opportunities as a separate list from postponed (diagnosis distinct from prioritization), instructional_mode as a string with the six valid values enumerated in the docstring, cycle_status as a three-value discipline (continue/consolidate_and_return/stop). Default_factory on DevelopmentalTheory.scaffolding_control (line 207) yields the correct empty-shape default on GET — verified in test_create_get_patch_and_default_scaffolding_control (all 9 fields empty).

server.py — RECURSIVE DEVELOPMENTAL SCAFFOLDING CONTROLLER block (line 371) is architecturally excellent: (i) explicitly frames itself as the ORCHESTRATION layer that coordinates M6-M10 lenses rather than replacing them ('You now hold many framework lenses...'); (ii) the six-step MASTER DEVELOPMENTAL LOOP (identify unit -> confirm purpose -> diagnose across all frameworks -> prioritize EXACTLY ONE -> choose an instructional mode -> evaluate + consolidate + return control) forces the LLM to think in a bounded cycle rather than an open-ended teaching session; (iii) 'NEVER teach multiple major concepts in one turn — the single student-facing invitation must address only the primary target' — verified live: the multi-weakness test had 5 diagnosed opportunities + 4 postponed, and the invitation itself had zero multi-target enumeration signals (no 'first,' / 'second,' / '1)/2)' phrasing); (iv) the mode-to-intervention-type coordination ('developmental_question/invite -> interpretation_only|invite_only; explicit_instruction -> instruct_then_invite; consolidation -> consolidate') is the right wiring between the M11 controller and the earlier Developmental Instruction Layer — verified on the independence turn (mode=consolidation and iv.type=consolidate matched); (v) STOPPING RULES with two MANDATORY sub-rules — INDEPENDENCE REQUEST and DIMINISHING RETURNS ON A TARGET — are the exact fixes flagged in milestone11_review.md; both verified live (independence request test hit stop + 'student requests independence' + consolidation, and repeated-revision test showed progressive target shift, not recursion).

server.py — theory output schema for scaffolding_control (line 435) matches the Pydantic model 1:1 and explicitly documents the valid enum values inline in the prompt ('developmental_question | explicit_instruction | brief_demonstration | guided_revision | reflection | consolidation' and 'continue | consolidate_and_return | stop'). This constraint discipline is why the LLM returned only valid mode/cycle_status values on 8/8 live turns (zero out-of-enum leaks).

server.py — _compact_theory (line 493) surfaces scaffolding_control.model_dump() into the per-turn prompt alongside cp/pf/ef/cf/concl — which is why the controller behaves recursively across turns (turn N sees turn N-1's primary_target + cycle_status and either consolidates or shifts). Verified on the consolidation multi-turn test: turn2 saw turn1's target and produced iv.type=consolidate on the real revision; turn3 saw the absorbed target and progressed to a NEW target rather than re-teaching.

server.py — the placement of the M11 block AFTER the FUNCTIONAL CONCLUSION FRAMEWORK (M10) is right: the controller layers on top of every earlier lens rather than replacing them. Pedagogically this is the master-cycle-on-top-of-domain-lenses architecture the milestone specifies.

server.py — M5A boundary preserved: 'This controller governs sequencing only; it never overrides the WRITING INSTRUCTION BOUNDARY (M5A) or the one-invitation rule' (line 381). Verified across 8 live SSE turns: intervention.focus='writing' + writing_not_content_check populated on every non-independence turn; no invented content on any turn.

frontend/DevelopmentPanel.jsx — scaffolding-control-block (line 202) is correctly placed as the SECOND block (right after communicative-purpose-block / M6, before paragraph-function-block / M7) — matching the pedagogical layering (purpose-then-orchestrator, then the domain lenses). The block shows ALWAYS (no applies gate) — appropriate because the controller runs every turn. Fields are laid out clearly: unit / diagnosed opportunities (List) / primary target (amber emphasis) / why (priority) / mode (emerald emphasis) / postponed (List) / cycle status (sky emphasis) / stopping reason (conditional) / future opportunity (conditional). The color discipline (amber=target, emerald=mode, sky=status) makes the orchestration read at a glance.

frontend/DevelopmentPanel.jsx — the color-coded field emphasis (primary_target amber / mode emerald / cycle_status sky) is a genuine UX win — a teacher scanning the panel can see the ORCHESTRATION at a glance: 'this turn, the target is X, taught via Y, and the cycle is Z.' Verified in the browser screenshot: with the multi-weakness draft, primary_target='Forming a controlling claim distinct from the topic' (amber), mode='explicit_instruction' (emerald), cycle_status='continue' (sky) — all three primary orchestration fields readable in one glance.

milestone11_scaffolding_eval.py + milestone11_recheck.py + milestone11_review.md — the 30-case internal eval discipline (with a targeted recheck after two stopping-rule fixes) is exactly the pattern that lifted M7/M8/M9/M10 to 30/30 and it holds here as well. milestone11_review.md documents the recheck honestly (initial 23/30 -> 30/30 after fixing case 22 independence + cases 28-29 diminishing returns), which is the right engineering discipline for a controller that must not regress silently.

Regression coverage: The full M6-M10 chain still populates correctly on M11's watch — the controller does not crowd out the domain lenses. On the supported body paragraph, pf.applies=True + ef.applies=True + cf.applies=True + scaffolding_control populated. On the ending draft, concl.applies=True + completes_purpose populated + scaffolding_control populated. On the multi-weakness draft, cp.primary populated + scaffolding_control populated. This layered coexistence (domain lenses + orchestrator) is the hardest architectural property to preserve when adding a meta-layer, and it holds.

rca of the issue: No functional defect. All 10 backend tests + all 6 frontend checks passed first-try. The controller architecture is disciplined at the prompt level (six-step master loop + enumerated mode values + three-value cycle_status + MANDATORY independence + diminishing-returns rules) and cleanly wired end-to-end (Pydantic ScaffoldingControl model -> reasoner block -> _compact_theory recursion -> Dev Panel block with color-coded emphasis). Highest-risk case (multi-weakness draft where the temptation is to teach multiple things) came through cleanly: 5 diagnosed opportunities but ONE primary_target + 4 postponed + no multi-target enumeration in the invitation. Highest-risk stopping case (independence request) came through cleanly: cycle_status=stop + stopping_reason='student requests independence' + mode=consolidation + iv.type=consolidate + no new instructional target. Highest-risk recursion case (revision on the same target) came through as PROGRESSIVE scaffolding — turn2 target shifted from claim to body-paragraph-function with iv.type=consolidate, turn3 target shifted again — the controller does not re-teach an absorbed target. On the frontend side, the one apparent 'failure' in the first browser run (writing-area not empty after new-test-session-button click) was a test-side artifact — the dev panel overlay was open when the click was fired and the reset flow needs the session-create round trip; a clean retest with panel closed showed reset completes in <1s. No code changes required.
